sources.standingLedger: audits/LEDGER.md — defects found by QA passes

ledger.description: Beat rebuilt from a 4-field whitelist; undo drops `holes`, `audioStart`/`audioEnd`, `fadeIn`/`fadeOut`
ledger.statusRaw: **wontfix 2026-09-09** — merging from disk on undo would make every cut permanent. The live loss needs GET to drop a field; it does not (6 fields pinned round-tripping in `tests/undo-round-trip.test.mts`)

ledger.description: `failJob` is the one mutator that doesn't `persist()`; failed builds stay "running" everywhere else and then 409 the next build
Upload buffered whole, twice, no size cap; a 1.4GB original OOMs and the catch then deletes the new project dir. Same at `references/route.ts:60`
Unbounded stdout accumulation over a 6-hour cap, and unbounded `job.log` re-serialised every 2s
CWD-relative `projects/<name>` where every other caller passes an absolute path; take picker 422s after migration
`spawnSync` + `import faster_whisper` on the request path of eight GETs, 60s cache
Split spreads holes and detached audio onto both halves; the line renders twice
Trim never re-runs `normaliseHoles`; a hole can end up covering the whole beat
`cutTimeline` strips any `-<digits>`; real beats `hook-1`/`hook-2` collapse into one
`updateReviewState(p, () => {})` is a full read-modify-write, so a GET rewrites `review-state.json` and can lose a concurrent write
ledger.statusRaw: **fixed 2026-09-09** — the reads are reads, a no-op update does not write, and an unreadable file is kept aside instead of replaced by defaults (it was destroying every take pick)

ledger.description: Cache key omits the cut file; scrub v2, see v1's frames
`count` never NaN-checked; `NaN` reaches argv and the cache key
`measured.map((_, i) => files[i])` indexes the input array by output position; wrong files credited in `house-style.json`
`g${Date.now().slice(-6)}` collides every 16m40s; deleting one graphic deletes both
ffmpeg/Whisper spawned without `runningJob()`; twelve filmstrips render at once on page load
Cut length ignores holes; `lib/snapshots.ts:129` subtracts them. Same edit, two durations
`read()` swallows every error and returns `{products: []}`, which PATCH writes back over the catalogue
416 for a range past EOF instead of clamping to `size - 1`

gauntletFixed.title: a working transcode is killed for being quiet
gauntletFixed.detail: make_source_proxy.py ran ffmpeg with -nostats, so a 1.8GB transcode was silent and the 5-minute idle watchdog killed it. Now -progress pipe:1.

gauntletFixed.title: one bad beats.json emptied the whole queue
gauntletFixed.detail: loadBeats was a bare JSON.parse with a cast; a throw propagated out of summarizeAllProjects and 500'd /api/projects.

gauntletFixed.title: a negative EDL duration ran the timeline backwards
splitting a beat said the line twice
gauntletFixed.detail: LEDGER S7. Both halves spread the whole beat, so both claimed the same detached audio. Invisible until the export.

gauntletFixed.title: ten routes 500'd on a JSON body of null
./scripts/test said all green without running the bug board
ten seconds of dead air in the middle of the cut
gauntletFixed.detail: walk_pieces required a detected pause to END inside the beat; a trailing pause is the commonest shape and was the one that could not be trimmed.

gauntletFixed.title: reading the review state destroyed it
one pause reported as two touching rows was never trimmed
delete said it cut, and cut nothing
gauntletFixed.detail: A highlight inside an existing hole merged into it, saveBeats skipped the no-op write, the route answered 200, the client cleared the highlight and toasted a cut.

gauntletFixed.title: a no-op trim taught the tuner a zero-delta edit
the changed signal covered 2 write paths of 8
a no-op left a dead step on the undo stack
the playhead teleported out of holes while PAUSED, not just while playing
gauntletFixed.detail: onTimeUpdate skipped holes unconditionally; a scrub fires timeupdate, so dragging near cut footage yanked the playhead away. Reported as 'it keeps auto-snapping'.

gauntletFixed.title: double-clicking Import ran the import loop twice
gauntletFixed.detail: The button disables on React state; the second click lands before the re-render. Now a synchronous ref guard.

openDefects.title: the word-level highlight never renders
openDefects.detail: Line-level tracking works. Word-level produces zero .wd elements in either player mode, playing or paused; the React hook holding {label,wordIx} is null at runtime. Transcript, beatsRef, liveMode, the rAF loop and the player element were each ruled out. Root cause NOT isolated.
openDefects.code: app/projects/[project]/review/page.tsx — the rAF loop that calls setSpoken, and the render at the beat row's .txt span

openDefects.title: 11 repeated phrases in img-9817's current cut
openDefects.detail: verify_cut.py reports them. ugc-edit-system/CLAUDE.md calls this the only check that reflects what a viewer actually hears. Down from 13.

openDefects.title: the auto pipeline's review render is 720p and nothing on screen says so
openDefects.detail: Deliberate (lib/pipeline.ts stepBuild passes {proxy:true}); pressing Build gives full resolution. The two are not distinguished in the UI, so a 406x720 file can be mistaken for the deliverable.

openDefects.title: a partial-overlap cut reports the whole highlight length
openDefects.detail: Cutting a region that is half inside an existing hole removes only the new part but the toast names the full selection.

suppressions.note: Counted by grep over app/ and lib/. Each is a deliberate 'this failure is not worth surfacing' decision; a gauntlet should probe whether any of them hides a real failure. lib/jsonStore.readJson returning a fallback for an unparseable file was exactly this shape and caused BUG-008.
suppressions.flakyHistory: tests/pipeline.test.mts had a timing test failing ~1 run in 15 (200ms cadence under a 1s idle window); widened to a 2s window and swept 15 clean runs.
